description: Open a request to the Fine Structure platform team: a bug, a feature request or a question about the platform itself (not about the user's app). Use it when something in the platform blocks you instead of working around it. Give a reproduction the team can run (invoke_function / curl / the exact tool call and result), what you expected, and how the team will know it is closed. Credential-looking values are redacted. Returns request_id and a Studio URL; the team's replies, status changes and deployments come back through get_platform_request / list_platform_requests. Limits: 20 per account per day, 32 KB.

acceptance.description: How the team will know it is closed

app_id.description: Optional: the app where it showed up

attachments.description: Optional app file paths or log ids

body.description: Free text, markdown allowed: context, impact, what you tried

reproduction.description: Steps, invoke_function calls or curl commands that reproduce it

title.description: One line, what is wrong or missing
